clue.text: Astral power is untrue? I could be upset by that

definitions.text: Astral power is untrue? I could be upset by that

indicators.note: to be upset is to be knocked over and disordered, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: P is the standard abbreviation for power in physics

explanation.surface: Someone who believes in astral forces bristles at the suggestion that they are false.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like an emotion but is the anagram signal on ASTRAL, P and ISUNTRUE together. Read whole, the clue also describes the believer who would be offended.
explanation.definitionFit: A believer in forces beyond nature would be offended by a claim that astral power is false.

clue.text: Mr Toad's unexpectedly finding fame

indicators.note: something happening unexpectedly comes out of the usual pattern, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, with the apostrophe dropped and its S kept

explanation.surface: Mr Toad, the boastful hero of a children's novel, suddenly finds himself famous.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrity status is a synonym for fame, the condition of being a star.

clue.text: Devout prior is dismissing reverend

indicators.note: dismissing someone sends them away, so these letters are taken out of the longer word

parts.note: prior means coming before, i.e. previous
Rev is the usual abbreviation for reverend, a cleric's title

explanation.surface: A religious prior is so devout that he sacks a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prior' looks like a monk but is the adjective meaning earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone deeply religious and faithful in observance.

clue.text: Port's gradual decline over period when public prosecutor's brought in

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over, i.e. above, the next

parts.note: rot is a gradual decay or deterioration

indicators.note: something brought in is placed inside another, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a term is a fixed period, such as a school term
DA stands for district attorney, the American public prosecutor

explanation.surface: A harbour city's slow decline continues through a spell when a prosecutor is appointed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch city is one of the largest seaports in Europe.

clue.text: Supporter's friendly, but only after the start

indicators.note: only what comes after the start is kept, so the first letter is dropped

parts.note: pally is informal for friendly

explanation.surface: A backer is warm and friendly, though only once things get going.
explanation.definitionFit: An ally is someone on your side who backs you in a dispute.

clue.text: Remarkable ruins regularly found on open land

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece is found on top of the second
taking letters at regular intervals picks every second letter of the word

parts.note: a common is an area of open public land

explanation.surface: Notable ruins keep turning up on a stretch of open land.
explanation.definitionFit: Something out of the ordinary is unusual and therefore remarkable.

clue.text: Agent letting go of fine player

indicators.note: letting go of something means releasing it, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a factor is an agent who does business for another
F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads

explanation.surface: A theatrical agent drops a good performer from the books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Agent' and 'player' suggest a sports agent; FACTOR is the older sense of agent.
explanation.definitionFit: A player is a performer on stage, the same as an actor.

clue.text: Basically, where some Germans live since abandoning crime

parts.note: Essen is a large city in Germany, so its residents live in Essen

indicators.note: abandoning something leaves it behind, so those letters are dropped

parts.note: taken as written before the deletion
a sin is a wrongdoing, a moral crime

explanation.surface: Some Germans have, at heart, lived in one place ever since giving up crime.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means at bottom or fundamentally, the same as basically.

clue.text: News I'd got in can generate shock initially

indicators.note: something got in is put inside, so one piece sits within another

parts.note: a tin is a can for food
taken as written without the apostrophe

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the first letters of the words are taken

explanation.surface: Somebody reports news they received that might cause a shock.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidings is an old-fashioned word for news or information received.

clue.text: Pope's succession is so topical after Reformation

indicators.note: a reformation forms something anew, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: The question of papal succession is newly relevant after the Protestant Reformation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reformation' looks like the historical event but tells you to re-form SO TOPICAL. 'succession' belongs to the surface, echoing apostolic succession.
explanation.definitionFit: The papacy is called the Apostolic See, so apostolic can mean belonging to the pope.

clue.text: Mind when going around right turn

indicators.note: going around something encloses it, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to tend is to look after or mind

explanation.surface: Watch out when going round a right-hand bend.
explanation.definitionFit: A trend is a general direction or a turn things take, as in a new turn of events.

clue.text: Wishes to dispose of current attractive property

indicators.note: disposing of something gets rid of it, so a letter is removed

parts.note: desires are wishes
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Someone longs to sell a lovely house.
explanation.walkthrough: DES RES is British estate-agent shorthand for a desirable residence.
explanation.definitionFit: The estate-agent phrase means a desirable residence, a home buyers will find appealing.

clue.text: Lock up mischievous child that's audibly in revolt

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child

indicators.note: audibly means as heard, so the word is spelt as it sounds

parts.note: people who have risen up are in revolt

explanation.surface: Someone wants to jail a naughty youngster who is noisily rebelling.
explanation.definitionFit: To imprison is to confine someone in a cell, as a jailer locks them up.

clue.text: Strain of me keeping benefit money back

indicators.note: keeping something holds it inside, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: my means belonging to me, of me

indicators.note: going back means reading from the end, so the word is reversed

parts.note: the dole is British state unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: A man feels the strain of having to pay back his welfare money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strain' suggests stress but means a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A strain is a passage of music, a tune heard, the same as a melody.

clue.text: What may be eaten cooked along with suet

indicators.note: cooked food is changed by preparation, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some dish is prepared using suet as an ingredient.
explanation.definitionFit: The French name for the spiny lobster, a shellfish often served as food.

clue.text: Extremely quiet reflected echo system for voices

parts.note: so means very, extremely
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

indicators.note: a reflection shows things the other way round, so the word is reversed

parts.note: sonar locates objects by echoes of sound

explanation.surface: A very quiet echo bounces back through a system designed for singers.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the highest female or boy singing voices in a choir.

clue.text: French politician requiring wealthy to reside in EU

parts.note: rich means wealthy

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: taken as written, the European Union
to lie is to be situated or reside somewhere

explanation.surface: A French politician needs to be rich to live in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal Richelieu was chief minister of France under Louis XIII.

clue.text: Lass endlessly kicked up fuss over dance music

indicators.note: in a down clue, kicked up sends the word upwards, so it reads backwards
with no end the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a lass is a girl
ado is fuss or bother
on means over, about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: A girl kept making a scene about the music played for dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts GIRL to GIR, and 'kicked up' turns it into RIG.
explanation.definitionFit: The rigadoon is a lively old Provençal dance and the music written for it.

clue.text: Reject post offered verbally by man on board in Chinese company?

indicators.note: something offered verbally is spoken, so the words are spelt as heard

parts.words: man on board in Chinese company
parts.note: a junk is a Chinese sailing ship and a male is a man, so a man aboard one

explanation.surface: Some unwanted post comes by word of mouth from a sailor in a Chinese firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsolicited advertising through the letterbox is the kind of post people throw away.

clue.text: Endless delight — give thanks for being at leisure?

indicators.note: endless means without its end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: joy is delight
to bless can mean to give thanks, as in saying grace

explanation.surface: Giving thanks for unending delight while at leisure.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the jokey definition: being out of work is a kind of enforced leisure.
explanation.definitionFit: Being out of work gives one free time, so idleness is humorously called leisure.

clue.text: Run away without energy to cry

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: scram means go away quickly
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone flees, too exhausted to weep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like a deletion but here means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A scream is a loud piercing cry.

clue.text: Life jacket requiring reversed stitch in side

indicators.note: reversed means turned around, so the whole combination is read backwards
in puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
to sew is to stitch

explanation.surface: A life jacket needs its seams turned and resewn along one side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' turns the whole combination round, giving TSEWEAM read backwards. RAF crews named the inflatable jacket after a buxom Hollywood actress.
explanation.definitionFit: The Second World War inflatable life jacket was nicknamed after an American actress.

clue.text: General route that took in Chicago and Oklahoma!

definitions.meaning: a ... is a wide, general path

definitions.text: that took in Chicago and Oklahoma!
definitions.meaning: the New York theatre district staged the musicals Chicago and Oklahoma!

explanation.definitionFit: The New York avenue and theatre district is literally a broad way and hosted both shows.

clue.text: Doctor's enemy drank but never managed to hold drink

indicators.note: holding something keeps it inside, so one piece contains the other
never having done something leaves it out, so those letters are removed

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business
ale is a drink, beer

explanation.surface: An opponent of a medic drank heavily but could never keep it down.
explanation.walkthrough: The Doctor is the hero of the BBC TV series Doctor Who, whose arch-enemies are robotic aliens. 'never' removes RAN, leaving DK.
explanation.definitionFit: These armoured aliens are the Doctor's best-known foes in Doctor Who.

clue.text: Novel type of small-scale dish with Aberdeen Angus?

parts.note: wee is Scots for small
a pie is a baked dish

explanation.surface: A tiny pie made with Scottish beef.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with Aberdeen Angus' hints that the word for small is a Scottish one; Aberdeen Angus is a Scottish breed of beef cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a sentimental book or film designed to make readers cry.

clue.text: Quickly turn to drink when sons leave — a pretty picture

indicators.note: to leave is to go away, so those letters are removed

parts.note: to spin is to turn quickly
to sup is to drink
S is the abbreviation for son, so sons gives two

explanation.surface: Turning swiftly to drink once the boys have gone, a glamorous image.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a picture of an attractive person pinned on a wall.

clue.text: Dad's absent from meal: there'll be leftovers

indicators.note: something absent is missing, so those letters are taken out

parts.note: a repast is a meal
pa is an informal word for dad

explanation.surface: Father missed dinner, so there will be food left.
explanation.definitionFit: What remains, the remainder, is the same as the leftovers.

clue.text: Bashing out an arrangement, please spare the piano frame

indicators.note: bashing out an arrangement suggests letters being knocked into a new order
to spare something is to leave it out, so its letter is removed from the rearranged pool

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: Someone thumping out a tune begs others to spare the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a stand or frame for holding a painting or blackboard.

clue.text: Dutifulness one's seen in religious historian formerly around

indicators.note: around means on all sides, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: once means formerly

indicators.note: seen in places the letter inside the name

parts.note: the Venerable Bede wrote an ecclesiastical history of England
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Duty observed by a church historian of long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen in' and 'around' nest the pieces: the numeral goes inside the historian's name, and the word for formerly wraps the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Dutifulness is doing as one is told, compliance or obedience.

clue.text: What may up deliveries of vegetable supreme en cocotte?

indicators.note: en is French for in, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a cocotte is a prostitute, a strumpet
a pea is a vegetable
a king is supreme ruler

explanation.surface: A recipe for a vegetable supreme cooked in a casserole dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'en cocotte' looks like the French cooking term for a casserole, but cocotte also means a prostitute and 'en' means in.
explanation.definitionFit: An old megaphone-like device amplifies speech, so it boosts spoken deliveries.
